title: Craft Beer 6-pack

drivers.name: Supplier delivery short warning
drivers.evidence: Supplier note indicates potential delivery issue; no prior data on impact, but supply risk can reduce sales. Evidence is weak, so effect is small and shrunk.

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. The baseline already reflects a downward trend (trend_13_vs_prior_13_pct = -15.7%) and seasonal noise. The supplier's delivery short warning introduces supply risk, but no demand signal reduction is confirmed. Past promotions show uplifts, but none are active. The classical model's 1.00 multiplier is consistent with no known drivers. The noise-adjusted effect of past promotions (x1.44) is not applicable here. The only uncertainty is supply risk, which may suppress sales, but evidence is thin. Shrink toward 1.0 with mild downside spread.
